verdict.rationale: Check's documented API creates companies, employees and payrolls and handles taxes and money movement for partner platforms. It also offers over 30 embeddable Components that run payroll inside your own app and can be swapped for custom UI, which covers embedding payroll in a developer's product. missing for 10: explicit white-label branding/theming documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of a partner integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API

citations.quote: We handle the intricacies of taxes, money movement, and the production and filing of tax forms so that you can focus on building the best product for your customers.
demonstrates how to create companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls
over 30 Components, which allow you to easily onboard employees, run payroll, generate reports, and set up third-party integrations such as Quickbooks Online.
Components are easy to swap out for custom UI as your product evolves.
Components can be embedded in a number of places in your app, such as a sidebar, a modal, or on the app page itself.
